frames.subtitle: $1.6 trillion moves through travel every year...

frames.description: vintage sepia photo of optimistic office with women and men in 1950s wear, working on rows of old computers that represent the dated infrastructure that travel is built on
frames.subtitle: Still running on infrastructure built before the internet.

frames.description: Close-up, overhead angle, hands (young, diverse team) on a MacBook Pro keyboard, fingers mid-type. Screen shows early Engine interface—minimalist, clean lines, warm yellow accent color. Soft natural window light streaming across the desk. Shallow depth of field, focus on screen. Modern startup aesthetic. Warm color grading: soft whites, pale yellows, warm wood grain desk visible. Shot like an Apple product commercial. Cinematic and aspirational.
frames.subtitle: In 2017 we built a hotel booking tool.

frames.description: Flat-lay composition. Generic API documentation printed on white paper spread across desk, dozens of pages with identical code blocks and bland corporate logos (generic tech company emblems). Soft overhead lighting. Slightly out-of-focus scattered pages creating repetitive, monotonous pattern. Color grade: sterile white, corporate grays, clinical and uninspiring. Depth of field: most pages blurred, one page sharply in focus showing generic boilerplate code. Shot like a product-of-mediocrity still life.
frames.subtitle: But to get it right, we couldn't rely on generic APIs.

frames.description: Cinematic golden hour shot on a luxury hotel rooftop at sunset. Several silhouettes of mixed gender professionals drinking, cheersing, shaking hands against a glowing sky. City skyline blurred behind them in bokeh. Warm golden light wrapping around their figures, long shadows cast across rooftop. Shot from high angle, slightly wide-angle lens, casual and deliberate. Color grading: rich golds, warm oranges, deep blue shadows. Feels momentous and intentional. High-resolution, shot like a premium business magazine cover.
frames.subtitle: We went direct.

frames.description: Extreme close-up macro shot of a pen signing a contract. Pen tip mid-stroke on expensive paper with letterhead (luxury hotel logo visible). Shallow depth of field—pen and signature in sharp focus, background (stack of contracts, leather-bound folder) in soft blur. Warm overhead lighting casting the pen's shadow. Gold pen, cream paper, embossed texture visible. Color grade: warm blacks, golds, cream whites, subtle shadows. Shot like a moment of power and commitment. High-resolution detail photography.
frames.subtitle: Rooftop contracts. Proprietary supply. Real relationships.

frames.description: Macro/microscopic visualization of a complex pricing algorithm. Thousands of data points rendered as a three-dimensional lattice of glowing nodes (bright greens, blues, magentas) connected by flowing lines of light. Data points flickering and recalculating in real-time, creating a sense of constant optimization. Shot from inside the lattice looking outward, cinematic camera movement through the data. Color grade: deep blacks with neon accent colors, high contrast. Shot like the inside of a neural network. Ultra-detailed, high-resolution, feels technological and sophisticated.
frames.subtitle: The hard things. The things that take years and can't be bought.

frames.description: Medium shot of a construction crew (hard hats, work gear) in a small office space, gathered around a laptop showing Engine's hotel booking interface. They're pointing at flights and cars on the screen, discussing, collaborative. Natural window light from behind them creating a halo effect. Shot with warm, documentary-style color grading: earth tones, warm tungsten interior light, slight film grain. Depth of field: crew in focus, office background softly blurred. Feels real, human, and driven by customer need.
frames.subtitle: But one product wasn't enough. Customers needed more.

frames.description: Close-up photograph of a beautifully designed digital invoice displayed on a premium monitor. Invoice shows hotels, flights, cars consolidated into one document. Clean typography, professional layout, warm color accents highlighting key data. Shallow depth of field—invoice sharply in focus, modern desk elements softly blurred behind (notebook, pen, coffee). Soft office lighting with monitor glow. Premium and trustworthy aesthetic.
frames.subtitle: Direct Bill. A line of credit just for travel. Consolidated invoicing. Centralized billing. Compliance built in.

frames.description: Wide establishing shot of a large luxury hotel ballroom being set up for a corporate event, with people
frames.subtitle: Groups followed. Automated RFPs, negotiation, contracts. Complexity nobody else would touch.

frames.description: Split-screen diptych composition. Left half: exterior close-up of airplane wing at takeoff, golden hour light, engines glowing slightly, runway stretching behind in soft focus, sky in warm oranges and pinks. Right half: aerial drone shot of a rental car lot at sunset, rows of vehicles casting long shadows, clean geometric patterns of parking spaces, warm light across the asphalt. Both shots high-resolution, cinematic, emphasizing scale and infrastructure. Subtle motion blur suggesting movement. Color-matched warm golden hour aesthetic across both halves.
frames.subtitle: Then flights and cars came in 2024.

frames.description: Photograph of a modern desktop monitor displaying Engine's integrated platform interface. Hotels section prominent in foreground, flights and cars sections clearly visible in the same dashboard. Multiple UI layers visible showing the consolidated view. Clean modern office background slightly blurred. Shallow depth of field on screen. Warm and cool light mixing. Color grade: professional tech aesthetic. Shows integrated product in actual use.
frames.subtitle: Engine became the fastest growing all-in-one travel platform

frames.description: Three-dimensional digital diagram showing Engine's complete product ecosystem. Hotel, Groups, Flights, Cars, Direct Bill, Engine X rendered as distinct glowing modules arranged in a circle around a bright central core (shared infrastructure). Lines of connection flow between each module and the center. Shot from elevated 3/4 angle showing depth and hierarchy. Color grade: dark background, vibrant distinct colors for each product, core glows brightest in gold. Feels like technological moat visualized.
frames.subtitle: Every step forced the next. Every hard thing we did became why nobody could catch us.

frames.description: Product hero shot of Engine X card. Format & Style: Luxury product photography, editorial, cinematic, shot on medium format. Lighting: Warm accent lighting skimming across card edge, soft dark background, subtle rim-light emphasizing premium material quality, studio lighting perfected. Camera/Lens: 80mm macro lens, f/2.8, shot on Phase One XF IQ4 150MP camera, medium format. Angle & Framing: Card held at elegant 35-degree angle in hands (hands partially visible at edges), card in absolutely sharp focus, luxury background (hotel lobby or modern office detail) in soft bokeh, centered composition with negative space. Ultra high-resolution, luxury magazine aesthetic, premium product positioning.
frames.subtitle: Then 2026 arrived. Engine X. The corporate card.

frames.description: Engine X card at center with data streams converging toward it. Format & Style: Cinematic 3D visualization rendered as if photographed, editorial, dark studio environment. Lighting: Card glows with warm light, data streams rendered as luminous neon pathways, nodes pulse along streams, surrounding darkness absolute black, volumetric light effect. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.0, depth from foreground card to background data sources visible. Angle & Framing: Card positioned in sharp focus at frame center-foreground, data streams converge from all directions (up, sides, background), different data types color-coded (blues, golds, greens), sense of card being the convergence point of multiple intelligence streams. Technical but beautifully rendered, cinematic and data-driven.
frames.subtitle: Built on everything Engine knows about travel and spend.

frames.description: Smartphone screen displaying Engine X rewards dashboard. Format & Style: Product photography, editorial, cinematic, shot on digital. Lighting: Natural window light on phone from side, screen glow visible, warm diffused office light, soft shadows. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens, f/1.8, shot on Canon 5D Mark IV. Angle & Framing: Slight angled view of phone screen (3/4 angle showing screen content clearly), hands holding phone at bottom edge of frame, soft office background blur, shallow depth of field keeps screen content sharp. Warm interior light mixed with screen glow, shows actual value accumulation visually, financial app aesthetic.
frames.subtitle: Insane rewards. Up to 10% back on travel. 1.5% on everything else. No annual fees.

frames.description: Open MacBook displaying API documentation with developer logos visible on desk. Format & Style: Editorial documentary photograph, cinematic, shot on film stock. Lighting: Warm natural window light, soft overhead office light, monitor glow, mixed lighting creating visual interest, volumetric quality. Camera/Lens: 35mm lens, f/2.2, shot on Portra 400, Canon 5D. Angle & Framing: 45-degree angled view of open laptop, documentation visible and readable on screen, developer logos and startup stickers visible on desk surface around laptop, hands of developer visible at keyboard, warm natural light, inclusive and welcoming composition. Documentary realism mixed with cinematic quality.
frames.subtitle: The API came next. Everything Engine built is now available to anyone building a travel product.

frames.description: Four different product interface mockups arranged in grid on dark background. Format & Style: Composite digital render, editorial visualization, cinematic studio environment. Lighting: Each interface has subtle backlighting creating glow, dark background absolute black, subtle rim-light on interface edges, directional light emphasizing depth. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.4, grid composition with depth perspective visible. Angle & Framing: 2x2 grid of interfaces arranged with slight depth (front interfaces sharper, back interface slightly soft), each interface color-coded distinctly, visible connection pathways between interfaces showing Engine backbone beneath, dark negative space between interfaces. Shows diversity and unity simultaneously, ecosystem breadth visualized.
frames.subtitle: Fortune 500s build on Engine. Our competitors come to us for our supply.

frames.description: Single bright white node igniting at center of pure black background. Format & Style: Cinematic digital visualization, editorial, studio environment, shot as if photographed. Lighting: Brilliant white point-source light at center, concentric circles of energy radiating outward in golden and white hues, particle burst effect around node, volumetric light scattering. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/1.4, centered composition with perfect symmetry. Angle & Framing: Dead-center perfectly symmetrical composition, node occupying approximately 1/3 of frame, energy radiating outward to frame edges, pure black background with no additional elements, particle effects suggest explosive energy release. Clean, stark, momentous singularity moment.
frames.subtitle: Then AI arrived. And it changes everything.

frames.description: White AI node at top connected by luminous pathways to complex infrastructure lattice below. Format & Style: Cinematic 3D visualization, editorial render, shot with cinematic depth of field. Lighting: AI node glows bright white with halo, infrastructure lattice glows in multi-color neon (blues, magentas, golds), directional volumetric light emphasizing connection pathways, dark surrounding space. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.2, angled perspective from 3/4 view. Angle & Framing: AI node positioned in upper-middle of frame in sharp focus, infrastructure lattice below in equally sharp focus, connection pathways clearly visible, depth between layers visible, dark background, relationship between systems immediately apparent. Revelation moment visualized.
frames.subtitle: For us more than anyone.

frames.description: AI neural network interlocking with Engine infrastructure systems. Format & Style: Cinematic 3D visualization rendered as photographed, editorial, studio environment. Lighting: Organic AI side glows in purple/blue with soft diffuse light, geometric Engine side glows in gold/green with hard directional light, interlock area glows brightest where they meet, volumetric light throughout. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.0, depth perspective visible. Angle & Framing: 3/4 angled view showing interlocking systems equally, both systems in sharp focus, interlock region in center of frame, complementary colors emphasize perfect fit, background dark, sense of inevitability and design purpose. Beautiful technical visualization.
frames.subtitle: The infrastructure we spent eight years building is exactly what AI needs to work.

frames.description: Engine infrastructure at center with multiple surfaces connecting and lighting up around it. Format & Style: Cinematic 3D visualization, editorial render, dynamic studio lighting. Lighting: Core infrastructure glows bright, each connecting surface illuminates as it joins, distinct glow for each surface type, volumetric light throughout, dark background. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.2, radial perspective from center outward. Angle & Framing: Center-focused composition with core at absolute center, multiple surfaces (expense app, LLM chat, agent, widget, tool) positioned radially around core at equal distances, connection lines flow from center to each surface, each surface color-coded distinctly, dark background, sense of simultaneous multi-vector expansion. Rapid adoption visualized.
frames.subtitle: Every new interface. Every new agent. Every new platform that emerges in travel runs on what we built.

frames.description: Engine at luminous center with AI platforms orbiting around it in orbital patterns. Format & Style: Cinematic 3D visualization rendered as space visualization, editorial, dark environment. Lighting: Engine core glows brilliant gold/white like sun, orbiting platforms glow in cool accent colors, volumetric light suggesting gravity and force, dark space background. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.4, orbital perspective from above looking down. Angle & Framing: Perfect bird's-eye view showing three layers of orbital distances, Engine core at absolute center in sharp focus, orbiting objects arranged in concentric circles at different distances, all visible in sharp focus, dark negative space filling frame, astronomical visualization quality. Established dominance and gravitational pull visualized.
frames.subtitle: We don't chase the AI wave. We are what it runs on.

frames.description: Dense network visualization at peak complexity and brightness. Format & Style: Cinematic 3D visualization rendered as photographed, editorial, studio environment, maximum detail visible. Lighting: Network elements glow at maximum brightness, thousands of nodes visible each with subtle glow, data flow lines luminous, feedback loops visible as circular energy patterns, overall luminescence intense but readable. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens equivalent, f/2.8, positioned to show maximum density and complexity. Angle & Framing: Medium distance perspective on network showing expansive scope, densest elements centered, outer elements slightly less dense (perspective), all elements readable and detailed, dark background with network glowing against it, full color spectrum in network elements. Self-reinforcing moat at peak strength visualized, feedback loops apparent.
frames.subtitle: The more interfaces built, the stronger we get. The more bookings, the smarter our pricing. The more relationships, the better our supply.

frames.description: Early Engine team 2017 in small startup office, collaborating around whiteboard. Format & Style: Documentary photograph, editorial, cinematic, shot on film stock. Lighting: Natural window light, warm diffused office ambient light, idealistic and hopeful quality, soft shadows. Camera/Lens: 35mm lens, f/2.0, shot on Portra 400 (warm color palette), Canon 5D. Angle & Framing: Wide-angle interior shot from corner of small office, 5-6 team members visible collaborating, whiteboard prominent showing sketches and ideas, window light visible, warm natural grain, candid energy, casual but purposeful atmosphere. Feels like origin story, scrappy and idealistic, before the epic build.
frames.subtitle: We didn't set out to build infrastructure.

frames.description: Senior engineer standing at large whiteboard covered in technical architecture diagrams. Format & Style: Editorial documentary photograph, cinematic, professional environment, shot on digital with film aesthetic. Lighting: Warm natural window light from side, whiteboard bright and illuminated, technical drawings visible and legible, volumetric light quality, professional office ambiance. Camera/Lens: 50mm lens, f/2.2, shot on Ektar 100 color science. Angle & Framing: Medium shot of engineer at whiteboard showing technical complexity, confident posture, whiteboard drawings clearly visible, modern office background soft blur, natural light creating definition, represents the moment of commitment to the hard path. Confident and focused energy visible.
frames.subtitle: We set out to solve for our customers. The infrastructure was the only way.

frames.description: Overhead wide shot of Earth at night with global travel networks as luminous flows. Format & Style: Space visualization photograph, cinematic, NASA-quality realism, editorial render. Lighting: City lights warm amber/white, travel route lights in bright blues and golds, volumetric atmosphere glow at Earth's edges, dark space background. Camera/Lens: 200mm telephoto equivalent, f/2.8, shot from space perspective. Angle & Framing: Overhead view from approximately 500 miles altitude, Earth filling 70% of frame, travel networks crisscrossing visible continents, every connection point glowing with Engine infrastructure signature, thousands of simultaneous particles suggesting real-time transactions, warm and cool light balance. Global scale and commerce visualized as beautiful flow.
frames.subtitle: Now we're powering the future of travel.

frames.description: an abstract white orb on a white background
frames.subtitle: A world where every booking, on any platform, runs on Engine.
